model_annotation: This plot illustrates the sharpness contribution of ViT and ImageNet1k models during training. The x-axis, labeled "Training Steps," represents the progression of the training process, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 37700 and tick labels spaced approximately every 15080 steps. The y-axis, logarithmic in scale, is labeled "Sharpness Composition" and displays values between -10 and 0, with tick increments of 10. The blue line represents ViT, exhibiting a relatively stable position around -1 for the majority of training steps from 0 to 37700, with a value of approximately -0.98 at the start and -0.97 at the end. The orange line, representing ImageNet1k, begins at a position of approximately -0.97 at training step 0, and gradually decreases to a value of approximately -0.95 at training step 37700.
